opportunities.title: Preservation and Conservation: Historic buildings and structures

amount.raw: Generally, £1,000 to £30,000 (average approx. £15,000). Sometimes larger sums are considered.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, recognised public bodies, Community Benefit Societies, and Community Interest Companies (CIC) limited by guarantee. Project must be UK based, focus on a listed building or structure, and not be complete.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the preservation and repair of listed historic buildings, structures and architectural features, with special consideration for those conserving and re-using buildings at risk of outstanding importance. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis; stage two applications over £5,000 considered quarterly at Board meetings.

opportunities.title: Preservation and Conservation: Places of worship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Anglican churches apply via the ChurchCare conservation grants scheme (part-funded by the Trust); all other denominations, faiths and cathedrals may apply directly to the Trust. Redundant/closed places of worship seeking sustainable uses apply under Historic Buildings and Structures.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of historic interiors and historic objects in places of worship open for regular worship, including bells, books, manuscripts, clocks, plasterwork, metalwork, church plate, monuments, organs, paintings, stained glass, textiles, timberwork, wall paintings, churchyard structures, and conservation reports. Rolling stage one applications; stage two applications over £5,000 considered quarterly.

opportunities.title: Preservation and Conservation: Conservation of cultural heritage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, recognised public bodies, Community Benefit Societies, and Community Interest Companies (CIC) limited by guarantee. Applicants must not be eligible for the grant programmes run by AIM and NMCT.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of culturally and historically significant collections and objects, including works of art, books, significant ephemera, artefacts and archives. Conservation must be carried out by an accredited conservator, informed by a conservation report, and enable greater public access. Rolling stage one applications; stage two applications over £5,000 considered quarterly.
